description: NVDA Clipboard makes the Windows clipboard easier to explore and reuse with NVDA. You can browse clipboard content, keep a history, work with images and copied files, and synchronize content between computers.
changelog:
### 0.5.4

- Improved browsing performance for stored entries with large text or images.
- Reduced repeated verification of unchanged content during OneDrive synchronization.
